title: Clarification on AppStoreAppActiveApkSet versioning
summary: The API documentation now explicitly states that all APKs within an AppStoreAppActiveApkSet must belong to the same app version.
details: A minor update to the `AppStoreAppActiveApkSet` schema description clarifies that all APKs in a given set must share the same version code. This is a documentation-only change intended to clarify requirements for developers using multi-APK or app bundle publishing strategies to ensure installability consistency.
